required_clauses.title: Services and Statement of Work
required_clauses.description: Describes the scope of services, deliverables, and any Statement of Work or exhibits that control the engagement.

required_clauses.title: Fees, Invoicing, and Payment Terms
required_clauses.description: Specifies fee amounts or pricing model, invoicing cadence, payment due date, dispute procedures, and late-payment consequences.

required_clauses.title: Termination for Cause and Convenience
required_clauses.description: Provides notice periods, cure timelines for material breach, and survival of key provisions after termination.

required_clauses.title: Intellectual Property Rights Allocation
required_clauses.description: Allocates ownership of background IP and work product, including licenses needed to provide and use deliverables.

required_clauses.title: Data Protection and Privacy
required_clauses.description: Requires vendor to comply with applicable data protection laws, restricts use of customer data, and defines breach notification obligations.

required_clauses.title: Indemnification
required_clauses.description: Defines each party's obligation to defend and hold harmless the other from third-party claims arising from their actions, negligence, or breach.

required_clauses.title: Payment Terms
required_clauses.description: Defines invoicing cadence, due dates, accepted payment methods, and consequences for non-payment.

required_clauses.title: Delivery Obligations
required_clauses.description: Defines delivery timelines, acceptance criteria, and obligations for delays or failures to deliver.

required_clauses.title: Warranties
required_clauses.description: Defines warranties for goods/services, warranty period, and remedies for breach.

required_clauses.title: Limitation of Liability
required_clauses.description: Caps each party's liability and excludes certain categories of damages subject to carve-outs.

required_clauses.title: Confidentiality
required_clauses.description: Protects non-public and sensitive information exchanged under the agreement.

required_clauses.title: Governing Law
required_clauses.description: Specifies the governing jurisdiction and venue for dispute resolution.

required_clauses.title: Force Majeure
required_clauses.description: Excuses performance delays caused by events outside reasonable control.

required_clauses.title: Dispute Resolution
required_clauses.description: Defines procedures for resolving disputes, including negotiation, mediation, arbitration, or court.
